about: Shared cross-language vectors for READING the ISO 10303-21 HEADER of a source file (F4-2, #7778).
`text` is the whole file. `padBefore` inserts that many spaces before the FILE_SCHEMA record,
which moves it past the scan window without a megabyte of fixture. The window is 256 KiB on both
sides. `schemas` is FILE_SCHEMA's identifiers and `description` is FILE_DESCRIPTION's item list;
a row that omits one does not pin it.
The expectations are written from ISO 10303-21, not from either implementation: Part 21 has no
square brackets outside a string literal, a comment cannot be left open, and a keyword is a

cases.name: plain header
square brackets are ordinary text, not nesting
a comment that never closes hides every later record
a record before an unclosed comment is kept
a keyword is a whole identifier
a keyword not followed by a parenthesis is not the record
ENDSEC inside a literal does not end the header
a comment between the keyword and its parenthesis
a record 100000 bytes into the header is inside the window
a record 300000 bytes into the header is past the window
